request.style: English, Celtic folk, strong clear female vocal, fiddle, Celtic harp, tin whistle, bouzouki, bodhran, stirring and bright, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the hill country of Ephraim, between Ramah and Bethel's stones
Sat Deborah beneath the palm while Israel cried and groaned
Nine hundred iron chariots had kept them twenty years
The highways lay empty
And travelers kept to the winding trails

[Verse]
She sent for Barak in Naphtali and gave him the LORD's command
Go, march to Mount Tabor
With ten thousand at your hand
If you go with me, I will go
I will surely go with you, she said

[Chorus]
Awake, awake, Deborah
Awake, awake, break into song
I will sing to the LORD, I myself will sing
I will make music to the LORD, the God of Israel

[Verse]
The chariots came thundering across the Kishon plain
The earth shook, the heavens poured
The clouds poured down water
From the heavens they fought
The river Kishon swept them away

[Bridge]
Village life in Israel ceased
Until I, Deborah, arose
Until I arose, a mother in Israel

[Chorus]
Awake, awake, Deborah
Awake, awake, break into song
I will sing to the LORD, I myself will sing
I will make music to the LORD, the God of Israel

[Outro]
May those who love you be like the sun
When it rises in its strength
And the land had rest for forty years
